title: RADIO FM-S… & COIL …
summary: Ignition shield cover for the radio option (option group U69): a cover assembly that fits over the distributor and ignition coil to cut radio interference. Its ends sit on two brackets on the engine; at the ignition-shield end a wing bolt goes through the cover flange into the bracket tab, 20-30 LBS IN.

parts.name: COVER ASM.
parts.name_expanded: Cover assembly – ignition shield (over distributor and coil)

fastening.to: tab of the ignition-shield bracket on the engine (distributor side)
fastening.note: Wing bolt [2] goes through the end flange of cover [1] into the tab on the bracket beside the IGN SHIELD; the cover's other end lines up (dash-dot line) with the tab on the second bracket on the coil side. Brackets are marked ENGINE (supplied with the engine), not callouts on this sheet.
